name: Edel Photo Gallery
author: Edel Hearts

sections.description:
Edel Photo Gallery is a simple yet powerful photo gallery plugin tailored for creating stunning visual presentations on your WordPress site.
It features a full-screen lightbox, responsive grid layouts, and an intuitive admin interface to manage multiple gallery groups easily.

Features

  • Responsive CSS Grid layouts: Beautiful image grids from 1 to 6 columns.
  • Flexible image aspect ratios: Choose between Square, Landscape, Portrait, and Widescreen layouts.
  • Full-screen Lightbox: Click any image to view it in full screen, complete with smooth mouse-scroll zoom and keyboard navigation.
  • Global settings: Configure visual styles (gaps, frames, shadows) and titles across all galleries.
  • Individual gallery overrides: Easily override global settings for specific blocks by using shortcode attributes.
  • Internationalization (i18n): Fully translatable with native .po/.mo support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the edel-photo-gallery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to “Edel Photo Gallery” in the admin menu to create your first gallery group.
  4. Upload images, copy the generated shortcode, and paste it into any post or page.
sections.faq:
How do I override global settings for a specific gallery?

You can easily override your Gallery Settings by adding attributes directly to the shortcode.
For example: [edel_photo_gallery id="XX" columns="3" image_ratio="16/9" show_title="0"]

How do I navigate the Lightbox?

You can click the left or right arrows on the screen, use your keyboard arrow keys, or press Esc to close. To zoom into an image, scroll your mouse wheel up or down!
